title: fix(quests): paginate POLLEN-QUEST issue search in loadQuestIssues (fixes #15888)
author: zilin6666LYNSUN
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15888

## Problem
`loadQuestIssues()` fetches POLLEN-QUEST-labelled issues with a single un-paginated GraphQL `search(first: 100)` query. The repository currently has 129 such issues, so issues ranked beyond the first page are never loaded:

- completed bounties (closed by a merged PR) whose issue ranks past page 1 disappear from the quests board;
- `evaluateUser()` builds `issueProposals` only from the loaded set, so a user who completed one of these hidden bounties never receives the reward.

Verified: `search(first:100)` returns 100 with `pageInfo.hasNextPage = true`; page 2 contains issues like #11897 (closed by merged PR #11912), #8843 (closed by merged PR #8886), #10736 (closed by merged PR #10422/#13589).

## Change
Paginate `QUEST_ISSUES_QUERY` with `after` / `endCursor` in a loop, mirroring the existing `reportedIssueProposals()` pagination pattern in the same file. `loadQuestIssues()` now collects all pages before filtering, so every POLLEN-QUEST issue (open or merged-closed) is considered for quest cards and rewards.

## Notes
- No behavior change for repositories with <= 100 POLLEN-QUEST issues.
- Reuses the existing `PaginatedSearchData` type already defined in this file.

gist.headline: The quest board turns pages
gist.blurb: The quest board learns to turn the page. Completed bounties beyond GitHub’s first 100 search results get their cards and reward checks too.
gist.summary: loadQuestIssues() paginates POLLEN-QUEST issues using GitHub’s endCursor, so all 129 issues—including merged-closed bounties beyond the first 100—are considered for quest cards and rewards.
gist.impact: Contributors whose completed bounties fall beyond the first 100 issues get those quests considered when their Pollen rewards are evaluated.
